name: AddGatewayAuth

parameters.help_en: The authentication name
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:

JWT

OIDC

IDaaS

ExternalAuthZ (custom authentication service)
parameters.help_zh:
鉴权类型：

JWT
OIDC
IDaaS
ExternalAuthZ（自建的鉴权服务）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
This parameter applies when `Type` is `JWT` or `OIDC`.

For JWT authentication, this specifies the issuer (`iss`) of the JWT claims.

For OIDC authentication, this specifies the issuer (`iss`) of the OIDC claims
parameters.help_zh:
鉴权类型为JWT/OIDC时使用：

JWT：表示JWT claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人。
OIDC：表示OIDC claims 的iss(issuer)，即签发人
parameters.name: issuer

parameters.help_en: The JWT public key in JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) format
parameters.help_zh: JWT公钥，支持JSON格式
parameters.name: jwks

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the location of the JWT. Valid value:

HEADER: The token is in a request header.

By default, the token is read from the `Authorization` header and must be prefixed with `Bearer `. For example: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
parameters.help_zh:
JWT Token类型：

HEADER：通过Header传输

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：Authorization: Bearer token
parameters.name: token_position

parameters.help_en:
The name of the request header that contains the JWT.

The default value is `Authorization`
parameters.help_zh:
JWT Token保存的位置。

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_name

parameters.help_en:
The prefix for the token value in the header.

The default value is `Bearer `(note the trailing space)
parameters.help_zh:
JWT Token的前缀。

要校验的Token参数信息，默认是以Bearer为前缀放在Authorization header中，例如：`Authorization: Bearer token`
parameters.name: token_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to pass the token to the backend service after successful authentication
parameters.help_zh: 是否透传Token
parameters.name: token_pass

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the authorization mode.

`true`: Whitelist mode. Requests that match the specified hosts and paths can bypass authentication. All other requests require authentication.

`false`: Blacklist mode. Requests that match the specified hosts and paths require authentication. All other requests can bypass authentication
parameters.help_zh:
授权黑白名单模式：

true：白名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 不需要校验即可访问，其余都需要校验）
false：黑名单模式（名单中的 hosts + paths 需要校验，其余可直接访问）
parameters.name: is_white

parameters.help_en: This parameter is for internal use and should not be configured. Upon creation, an authentication rule is disabled by default
parameters.help_zh: 未开放参数，无需传递（鉴权创建后默认为关闭状态）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The URL to which the user is redirected after successful authentication. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC` or `IDaaS`. The URL must match the redirect URL configured in the OIDC or IDaaS provider
parameters.help_zh: 授权成功后的重定向地址（OIDC/IDaaS使用，需要与OIDC/IDaaS中配置的重定向地址保持一致。）
parameters.name: redirect_url

parameters.help_en: The client ID of the application registered with the identity provider. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC` or `IDaaS`
parameters.help_zh: 服务注册的应用ID（OIDC/IDaaS使用）
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The client secret of the application registered with the identity provider. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC` or `IDaaS`
parameters.help_zh: 服务注册的应用Secret（OIDC/IDaaS使用）
parameters.name: client_secret

parameters.help_en:
The cookie domain. After successful authentication, the gateway sends a cookie to this domain to keep the user signed in.

For example, if you set `Cookie-domain=a.example.com`, the cookie is sent to the `a.example.com` domain. If you set `Cookie-domain=.example.com`, the cookie is sent to `example.com` and its subdomains
parameters.help_zh:
Cookie的域名，认证通过后会将Cookie发送到指定的域名，保持登录状态。

例如：设置`Cookie-domain=a.example.com`，则Cookie会发送到域名`a.example.com`；设置`Cookie-domain=.example.com`，则Cookie会发送到`example.com`的所有子域名
parameters.name: cookie_domain

parameters.help_en: The OIDC scopes. This parameter is required when `Type` is `OIDC`
parameters.help_zh: OIDC授权作用域（OIDC使用）
parameters.name: scopes_list

parameters.help_en: The URL of the user logon page for the IDaaS instance. This parameter is required when `Type` is `IDaaS`
parameters.help_zh: IDaaS实例用户登录页地址（IDaaS使用）
parameters.name: login_url

parameters.help_en: The subject (`sub`) of the JWT claims. This parameter is used when `Type` is `JWT`. Ensure that the value of this parameter matches the `sub` field in the JWT payload. If this parameter is not set or is left empty, its value defaults to the value of the `Issuer` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权类型为JWT时使用；JWT claims 的sub（subject），即主体，请确保JWT的Payload中的sub字段的值与此处配置的值一致。如果该参数未设置或者为空，那么默认与Issuer参数设置的值一致
parameters.name: sub

fields.help_en: The request headers to pass to the custom authentication service
fields.help_zh: 鉴权请求中允许携带的头部
fields.name: allow_request_headers

fields.help_en: The response headers from the custom authentication service to pass to the backend service
fields.help_zh: 鉴权响应中允许保留的头部
fields.name: allow_upstream_headers

fields.help_en: The maximum size of the request body that can be sent to the custom authentication service, in bytes
fields.name: body_max_bytes

fields.help_en:
Specifies the behavior when the custom authentication service is unavailable:

`true`: Strict mode. If the authentication service is unavailable (for example, due to a connection failure or a 5xx error), the gateway rejects the client request.

`false`: Permissive mode. If the authentication service is unavailable, the gateway allows the client request to pass through
fields.help_zh:
自定义鉴权模式：

true：严格模式，当鉴权服务不可用时（鉴权服务建立连接失败或者返回5xx请求），网关拒绝客户端请求
false：宽松模式，当鉴权服务不可用时（鉴权服务建立连接失败或者返回5xx请求），网关放过客户端请求
fields.name: is_restrict

fields.help_en: The path of the authentication API provided by the authentication service. The path is matched by prefix
fields.help_zh: 鉴权服务提供的鉴权API的Path，API的Path需是前缀匹配
fields.name: prefix_path

fields.help_en: The ID of the authentication service
fields.name: service_id

fields.help_en: The timeout for the custom authentication service, in seconds
fields.help_zh: 鉴权服务的超时时间，单位：秒
fields.name: timeout

fields.help_en: The request header that contains the token, such as `Authorization` or `Cookie`
fields.help_zh: Token处于请求报文中哪个Header中，常见的有Authorization和Cookie
fields.name: token_key

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to rematch the route after the authentication is complete
fields.help_zh: 是否在鉴权完成后重新匹配路由
fields.name: with_rematch_route

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include the request body in the request sent to the custom authentication service
fields.name: with_request_body

parameters.help_en: The settings for the custom authentication service
parameters.help_zh: 自定义鉴权信息
parameters.name: external_authz_json

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 网关唯一标识ID
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The mode for configuring authorization resources. Valid values:

0: Simple mode

1: Advanced mode
parameters.help_zh:
授权资源模式：

0：简单模式
1：复杂模式
parameters.name: auth_resource_mode

parameters.help_en: The YAML configuration for the advanced mode
parameters.help_zh: 复杂模式的YAML配置
parameters.name: auth_resource_config

fields.help_en: The name of the request header
fields.name: header_key

fields.help_en:
The match condition. Valid values:

EQUAL: Equal to

NOT_EQUAL: Not equal to

EXIST: Exists

NOT_EXIST: Does not exist

INCLUDE: Contains

EXCLUDE: Does not contain

PREFIX: Has prefix

SUFFIX: Has suffix

REGEX: Regular expression match
fields.help_zh:
匹配条件：

EQUAL：等于
NOT_EQUAL：不等于
EXIST：存在
NOT_EXIST：不存在
INCLUDE：包含
EXCLUDE：不包含
PREFIX：前缀
SUFFIX：后缀
REGREX：正则
fields.name: header_method

fields.help_en: The value of the request header
fields.name: header_value

fields.help_en: A list of request header conditions to match. This parameter is applicable only to custom authentication rules
fields.help_zh: 规则的请求头（当前仅供自定义鉴权使用）
fields.name: auth_resource_header_list

fields.help_en: The ID of the domain name to which the rule applies
fields.name: domain_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether path matching is case-sensitive. This parameter is applicable only to custom authentication rules. For other authentication methods, path matching is case-sensitive by default.

`true`: Path matching is case-insensitive.

`false`: Path matching is case-sensitive
fields.help_zh:
路径是否开启大小写敏感（创建自定义鉴权时使用，其他鉴权类型默认开启大小写敏感）

true：开启大小写敏感
false：关闭大小写敏感
fields.name: ignore_case

fields.help_en:
The match type for the path. Valid values:

EQUAL: Exact match

PRE: Prefix match

REGEX: Regular expression match
fields.help_zh:
请求Path的匹配类型：

EQUAL：精确匹配
PRE：前缀匹配
ERGULAR：正则匹配
fields.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The list of authorization rules. Multiple rules are evaluated with a logical OR. Within a single rule, multiple match conditions are evaluated with a logical AND
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权的授权规则列表，多个规则条件之间是“或”关系，规则条件内的多个匹配项之间是“与”关系
parameters.name: auth_resource_list

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. Valid values: `zh` (Chinese) and `en` (English). The default value is `zh`
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of `200` indicates that `Success` is `true`

Data.description_en: The ID of the created authentication rule

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Valid values:

`true`: The request succeeded.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
